pre_condition: symbol_range is a dict with a 'start' key and an 'end' key, each mapping to a dict that contains a 'line' key with an integer value; each sub-dict may also contain a 'character' key with an integer value
post_condition: Returns (start, end) where both are non-negative integers and start <= end. start is the value of symbol_range['start']['line'] clamped to minimum 0. end is the value of symbol_range['end']['line'] clamped to minimum of start. When end > start and symbol_range['end']['character'] equals 0, end is reduced by 1, because an LSP half-open range ending at column 0 of line N contains no content on line N. The returned span is 0-indexed and inclusive.
